import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the sleep health dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a bar chart for the distribution of sleep disorders
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='Sleep Disorder', data=df)
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Disorders')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Disorder')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot for the relationship between sleep duration and quality of sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', data=df)
plt.title('Relationship Between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart for the distribution of BMI categories
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='BMI Category', data=df)
plt.title('Distribution of BMI Categories')
plt.xlabel('BMI Category')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output3.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a box plot for the distribution of heart rate by gender
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Gender', y='Heart Rate', data=df)
plt.title('Distribution of Heart Rate by Gender')
plt.xlabel('Gender')
plt.ylabel('Heart Rate')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output4.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
